title: Embedding Content
description: Learn how to embed external content like videos, maps, and other media using HTML tags.

quiz.question: Which HTML tag is commonly used to embed an external webpage within your webpage?
quiz.explanation: The <iframe> tag embeds another HTML page within the current page.

quiz.question: What attribute is required for the <iframe> tag to specify the URL of the embedded content?
quiz.explanation: The src attribute specifies the URL of the page to embed.

quiz.question: Which tag can be used to embed multimedia like videos or audio?
quiz.explanation: The <embed> tag embeds external content such as videos, audio, and plugins.

quiz.question: What is the difference between <object> and <embed> tags?
quiz.explanation: <object> allows alternative content if embedding fails; <embed> is a simpler tag without fallback.

quiz.question: Which attribute in <iframe> improves security by restricting what the embedded page can do?
quiz.explanation: The sandbox attribute applies restrictions to the content in the iframe for security.

quiz.question: How do you embed a YouTube video using HTML?
options: Using <video> with src set to YouTube URL
Using <iframe> with src set to YouTube embed URL
Using <object> with direct video file URL
quiz.correctAnswer: Using <iframe> with src set to YouTube embed URL
quiz.explanation: YouTube videos are embedded using an <iframe> tag with the YouTube embed URL.

quiz.question: Which tag would you use to embed an SVG image inline?
quiz.explanation: SVG images can be embedded inline using the <svg> tag.

quiz.question: Which attribute allows an <iframe> to go full screen?
quiz.explanation: The allowfullscreen attribute enables full-screen mode for iframes.

quiz.question: What is the primary use of the <canvas> element?
quiz.explanation: <canvas> is used for dynamic, scriptable rendering of 2D shapes and bitmap images.

quiz.question: To embed a Google Map in your webpage, which tag and attribute combination is typically used?
quiz.explanation: Google Maps are embedded using an iframe with the provided embed URL.
